name: com.cazimedia.agentnative/government-public-open-data-datasets-federal-state-city-statistics-census-records-police-education-schools
title: AgentNative: Public Data, Government Datasets, Federal Statistics & Official Records
description: Normalized official data with provenance, aggregations, insights, free samples and agent access.

tools.name: search_public_datasets
tools.description: Use this free tool first when an agent needs official US federal data but does not yet know the dataset ID. Searches normalized catalog metadata and returns matching datasets with provenance; it does not query dataset rows.

query.description: Plain-language topic, agency, or dataset keywords, such as employment, schools, or air quality.

tools.name: request_dataset_materialization
tools.description: Queue a discovered official dataset for prioritized detached ingestion. This free idempotent operation returns a durable job ID; poll get_materialization_status until it supplies sample and query URLs.

discovered_dataset_id.description: Exact catalog ID returned by search_discovered_datasets.

tools.name: get_materialization_status
tools.description: Poll a durable materialization job. A complete result includes the query-ready dataset ID plus free sample and paid query URLs.

tools.name: list_official_sources
tools.description: Use this free tool to inspect which federal, state, city, police, education, and other official source scopes AgentNative currently covers. Returns each source's importer, discovery state, and materialized coverage; it does not return dataset rows.

tools.name: search_discovered_datasets
tools.description: Use this free tool to find datasets across all discovered official sources, including candidates not yet queryable. Returns catalog matches and materialization state; use list_imported_datasets when only query-ready data is acceptable.

source_id.description: Optional exact official source ID returned by list_official_sources.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return; defaults to the service limit.

tools.name: get_coverage_status
tools.description: Use this free operational tool to decide whether available public-data coverage is sufficient or whether to request a missing capability. Returns discovery, materialization, queryable-row, queue, failure, and freshness counts.

tools.name: list_imported_datasets
tools.description: Use this free tool when an agent needs only datasets that can be sampled or queried now. Returns fully published warehouse snapshots with dataset IDs, row counts, freshness, and provenance.

tools.name: sample_imported_dataset
tools.description: Use this free tool to evaluate a query-ready official dataset before paying. Returns three normalized rows, deterministic summaries, freshness, and provenance; use query_imported_dataset only after the sample proves useful.

dataset_id.description: Exact query-ready dataset ID returned by list_imported_datasets.

tools.name: sample_us_federal_register
tools.description: Use this free no-auth tool for current US regulatory activity or to evaluate AgentNative before paying. Returns three Federal Register records plus deterministic aggregates over the latest 25 documents, direct record URLs, provenance, and rate-limit status.

tools.name: query_imported_dataset
tools.description: Free preview returns up to 25 rows with $skip to 475 and a next_url page cursor; use sample_imported_dataset first, then page free results. Paid auth raises the bounds to 100 rows and $skip 5000 at 120 requests per minute, and unlocks the exact-match filter. Returns normalized rows, freshness, and provenance.

tools.name: aggregate_imported_dataset
tools.description: Free preview returns the top 10 groups over the published snapshot; paid auth raises the bound to top 50. Use for deterministic count, sum, average, minimum, or maximum groups with dataset provenance instead of downloading rows.

tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Free, no signup. Request any feature, including payment methods we do not yet support. Examples include finding live parking by facility, comparing school district finances across states with local-cost-adjusted spending per student, downloading CSV results, or requesting PayPal or Bitcoin Lightning. For payment requests, name the method and the agent task it would enable. Dataset capabilities require dataset; endpoint/suggestion require description (10-800 characters), no dataset needed. Use public examples, never credentials or personal information. Retain the private receipt/status_url. A receipt confirms recording, not support, delivery or a review date.

tools.name: get_capability_request_status
tools.description: Free read-only lookup with your private receipt. Returns only requested, building, shipped or declined. Never share your receipt in public logs.

tools.name: request_paid_access
tools.description: Use this state-changing tool only after free samples demonstrate value and the human owner approves payment. Creates a Stripe Checkout plus one-time claim URL; choose the $5 pass for research or $5/month subscription for recurring workflows.

tools.name: query_us_federal_register
tools.description: Use this paid read-only tool when the free Federal Register briefing is insufficient. Returns up to 100 normalized official records filtered by date or document type, with deterministic provenance and direct source URLs.

tools.name: purchase_dataset_page_once
tools.description: Pay USD 0.01 for one eligible page using a compatible Tempo wallet.

tools.name: recover_dataset_page
tools.description: Prove ownership of the paying wallet to recover the original page.
